messages:
Priya S: Proposal — canonicalize how we emit provisional billing lines when final token events are missing. Require provenance_id from edge; allow fallback fingerprint but mark it as fallback. Provisional rows should have provisional=true, provenance_id, match_type, estimate_tokens, estimate_cents, provisional_ttl.

Maya R: Agree. Reconcile actions need to be idempotent: commit|adjust|void. Ledger must support PATCH for partial token deltas.

Kevin L: Console UX notes: show a subtle orange "Provisional" pill on preview lines, add filter ?provisional=true, and internal-only "Force commit" action with justification that writes to audit log. Hide provisional rows from external invoice exports by default.

Alex H: Metrics to emit: billing.provisional_emitted_total, billing.provisional_committed_total, billing.provisional_adjusted_total, billing.provisional_voided_total, billing.provisional_reconcile_latency_seconds p50/p95, billing.provisional_false_match_rate. Alert on reconcile_delta_pct_p95 > 2% or false_match_rate > 0.5% over 30m.

Priya S: Rollout plan: feature-flag billing.provisionals.v2, tenant opt-in. Canary path: 5 -> 50 -> 250. If fallback false_match_rate for a tenant exceeds threshold, disable fallback for that tenant.

Maya R: Producer contract: prefer X-Provenance header or client_req_id. Fallback fingerprint = sha256(tenant|route|approx_ts) and record match_type=fallback so ops know risks.

Kevin L: API examples:
GET /api/v1/invoices/preview?tenant=acme&include=provisional
Response lines include {"provisional":true,"provenance_id":"p_xyz","match_type":"provenance|fallback","estimate_cents":1234}\n
POST /billing/reconcile {"provenance_id":"p_xyz","action":"adjust","final_amount_cents":1100} (idempotent)

Alex H: Ops UX: surface per-tenant provisional percent and top provisional deltas. Add a small banner in console explaining provisional semantics and add a help-center article. For early rollout show UI only to internal roles.

console-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.30.0 deployed to staging; billing.provisionals.v2=false.

Priya S: I'll write the design doc and open PRs for schema + ledger + console + SDK. Tagging @Maya R @Kevin L for review.
